crosswalks.label: Information Security Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Information Security Analysts include encryption/security-control work but do not fully define cryptography engineering.

crosswalks.label: Cryptography
crosswalks.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 updated the Cryptography competency area, providing current task/knowledge/skill context without granting cryptographic authority.

findings.summary: Cryptography Engineering must bind mechanism claims to exact parameters, implementation and key lifecycle while keeping standardized-algorithm use separate from complete system security and novel-crypto research.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make algorithm-name-versus-system-security, key-lifecycle and novel-primitive review boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Cryptography Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
